transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, what brings me in is that my head just feels really foggy lately. I work as a personal care aide, and I've started making these little mistakes in my client notes, or... I'll just completely forget what I was about to do. It really isn't like me to be this scattered, so I wanted to come in and see what's going on.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy lately?

Yeah, I have been. Lately, I just wake up with this... heavy, empty feeling right in my chest. I mean, I can still get through my shift and talk to people just fine, but inside, I just feel really sad and flat.
Have you noticed that you feel tired or have a lack of energy almost every day?

Yeah, I have. It's... well, even on days when I really don't do much, my body just feels completely worn out. Just doing simple things, like helping a client with a shower or carrying in the groceries... it just takes a lot more out of me than it should.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough or been blaming yourself for things more than usual?

Yeah, I have been. I just keep replaying what I should have done for my tío before he died. Like... I should have called him more, or made the time to visit him sooner. I just think about it a lot, and I end up feeling like I really failed him as family.
Have you been having trouble thinking clearly or concentrating on tasks lately?

Yeah, I have. That's actually a big part of what brings me in. My head just feels... really foggy lately. I've been making these little mistakes in my client notes at work, or I'll just completely forget what I was about to do right in the middle of doing it. It really isn't like me to be this scattered.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?

No, not really. I mean... I still care about the things I usually like doing. Sometimes I might be too tired to actually do them as much, like I mentioned, but the interest is definitely still there. I still enjoy things just fine when I have the energy for them.
How long have you been feeling this way — with the sadness, fatigue, and difficulty concentrating?
It's been... I'd say about a month now. Yeah, right around a month that this low, guilty, foggy feeling has just been hanging over me.
Have you found yourself struggling to think clearly or focus on tasks more often than usual?

Yeah, like I mentioned a few minutes ago, that's actually the main thing that brought me in today. My head just feels incredibly foggy. I keep making these little mistakes in my client notes, or I'll just completely forget what I was about to do right in the middle of doing it. It's just really not like me to be this scattered.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently — like eating a lot more or a lot less than usual?
No, I haven't really noticed any changes there. My appetite has been pretty normal, I think, and my weight seems to be about the same as always. I'm just eating my regular meals.
Have you had any trouble sleeping lately — like difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking up too early in the morning?

Yeah, my sleep has been pretty all over the place lately. I either... well, I just lie there at night thinking about family stuff and can't drift off, or I end up waking up way before my alarm. And once I'm up like that, I can't really settle back down to get any more rest.
Have you noticed that you’ve been moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, have you felt restless or fidgety lately?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I don't feel restless or jittery, and... well, I don't think I'm moving or talking any slower than usual. Everything on that front feels pretty normal.
Have you gone through any major changes, losses, or stressful events in the past few months that might be contributing to how you’ve been feeling?

No, not really. I mean... I can't think of anything major. No big losses or huge life changes lately. It's just been the usual day-to-day stuff, really, just going to work and coming home. Nothing stands out that would be a big stressor or anything like that.
Have you had any thoughts about death or dying, or have you thought about hurting yourself in any way?

Well, I'm definitely not planning to hurt myself or anything like that. But... I guess there have been some mornings recently where I just think it wouldn't be the worst thing if I didn't wake up. Just kind of... not waking up at all. And honestly, having thoughts like that really scares me.
Can you tell me more about the thoughts you’ve had about your uncle’s death? Have you been feeling this sadness specifically around the time of his passing or has it been more general?

Well, the sadness is pretty constant right now, but a lot of it does tie back to my tío. I just... I keep replaying everything in my head. I keep thinking about what I should have done before he passed away. Like, I should have called him more, or made the trip to visit him sooner. I just end up feeling like I really failed him, you know? Like I let him down as family.
How long ago did your uncle pass away?
He passed away about two weeks ago. That's... that's really when this whole shift started. Everything just kind of went downhill for me right after that.
Would you say that your sadness and foggy thinking are affecting areas of your life beyond just how you feel about your uncle’s passing?

Yeah, it's definitely spilling over into everything else. I mean, at work—I'm a personal care aide—I've actually had to ask my coworkers to double-check my client documentation because I just don't trust my head right now. And at home... well, my wife has had to take over paying some of the bills and handling the scheduling. I'm just not as reliable with the details lately, and I don't want to mess anything up.
Would you say that your sadness is mostly about your uncle’s death, or has it taken on a life of its own, even when you’re not thinking about him?

I think it's taken on a life of its own now. I mean, I definitely still think about him a lot, but lately... lately I just wake up with this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. It's there before I even have a chance to remember why I'm sad. I can still get up, go to work, get through my shift and talk to my clients and everything. But inside, I just feel really sad and flat all day, even when I'm not specifically thinking about my uncle.
